title: Sunset Citrus Breeze

diffuser.notes: Add to a diffuser with water for a refreshing, calming summer room scent.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist around the room, not on skin.

why_it_works: Sweet orange lifts the mood with sunny brightness, lavender cools and calms, and peppermint adds a crisp, refreshing edge—perfect for warm summer evenings.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
